quote: Log inSign up for freemake me a negative review for gta viWriting1/10 – A Massive DisappointmentHonestly, GTA VI is nowhere near as good as everyone made it out to be. The hype was enormous, but the actual experience feels disappointing. The gameplay gets repetitive, the story is underwhelming, and some missions feel like a chore rather than something **** graphics might look impressive, but good visuals can't save a game that lacks engaging content and originality. It feels like Rockstar focused more on creating hype than delivering something truly revolutionary.After all these years of waiting, I expected something unforgettable.
